summary: The trace reveals a distinct capability: building capacity reconciliation Excel workbooks from JSON/CSV data with cross-sheet formulas, control rows, and specific openpyxl API patterns. This differs from the existing inventory-metrics-calculation skill (which reads/calculates from multi-sheet Excel inputs). The new skill captures the output-workbook construction workflow, three critical openpyxl pitfalls encountered (Border.Style, MergedCell clearing, float precision), and the verification pattern for formula-linked summary sheets.
